title: The first page of a chat is asked from render and a failed send is dropped, so no Failed/Retry shows
trigger: Open an empty-looking chat while the client's send path rejects fetch_history (not Closed yet)
effect: maybe_auto_load_older discards the send error (.ok().flatten()), so history stays empty with no loading or failed mark and render defers the same ask every frame; the user sees an empty pane without Retry
fix: fetch_history marks the first page Failed on a send error, as fetch_contacts does with fail_dropping_data

title: reported_visible de-dup key outlives the open generation, so a reopened chat may never report its rows
trigger: Open chat A with unread rows (rows reported), go back to the list (or to a chat that reports nothing), reopen A with the same visible rows
effect: prepare_history_view restarts the ViewBook (Unreported, opened_with_unread: nothing is read) but the UI key (chat, ids) still equals the new ids, so view_messages is skipped and the visible unread rows stay unread until the view scrolls
fix: Key the report by the session view generation (store (generation, chat, ids)) or clear reported_visible when the shown chat changes or closes

title: TermsStage::Terms { age_ok, age_error } keeps an attempted-press bool beside the tick
trigger: Agree pressed without the age tick sets age_error; ticking clears it; Decline then Back resets both through TermsStage::default()
effect: None today (the unreachable ok+error pair is not produced); the error is a one-bit stage held by hand
fix: enum AgeCheck { Unticked, Refused, Ticked }

title: baseline: ChecklistDialog::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done (and +error beside error field)
trigger: Baseline entries ChecklistDialog::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done and ChecklistDialog::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done+error are still listed; the bool is a user choice (TDLib todo option) beside an error field
effect: Not a stage, but still in the debt list; the checker flags it only by its word list
fix: Move to scripts/implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason (a setting of the list being made) or hold options in a ChecklistOptions struct

title: ChecklistDialog::error is set on a failed validation and never cleared until the box closes
trigger: Press Create with an empty title (error line appears), type a title, add tasks or flip a switch
effect: The stale error line stays under the fixed form until the next successful submit closes the box
fix: Derive the line from the draft at render (draft.validate()) after the first press, or an enum Form { Fresh, Refused(reason) } cleared on edit

title: AddContactDialog holds two stage enums (stage, save) chosen by user_id == 0
trigger: New Contact box (user_id == 0) uses stage; Add Contact box (user_id != 0) uses save; the other field is dead but writable (submit_new_contact / submit_add_contact_dialog each guard only their own)
effect: None today; a path that sets the wrong one would show no spinner and no way out
fix: enum ContactBox { New(NewContactStage), Existing { user_id, save: ContactSave } }

title: Reset-statistics send failure is parked in data_storage_save, another request's slot
trigger: Reset statistics > Reset while the send fails (connection closed), then retry and succeed, or save an auto-download network
effect: The 'Reset statistics failed' line stays on the page until an unrelated Save succeeds or the page is re-arrived; the answer-side failure of the same request goes to privacy_data.network instead, so one request has two failure homes
fix: Put the reset's own failure in the network Fetch (fail on send error) and drop the data_storage_save write

title: NetworkReset { Idle, Confirming } is the old confirming bool; the reset request itself has no stage
trigger: Reset statistics > Reset: the box goes back to Idle at once while resetNetworkStatistics is in flight
effect: No bug today (the Fetch<NetworkUsage> shows Loading and the answer error lands there), but a two-variant enum beside the real stage (the request, held nowhere) and a second confirm mechanism (settings.storage_confirm: Option) on the same page
fix: One page-confirm value (Option<PageConfirm::{ClearStorage(..), ResetNetwork}>) and the reset request in privacy_data.network

title: CopyMark::Copied { at } names a timer; the Task is detached in folder_share/mod.rs:367
trigger: Copy an invite link in Share Folder
effect: No bug today (the timer compares at before clearing); the stage cannot cancel its own clear, and each copy leaves a live sleeping task
fix: CopyMark::Copied { link, _clear: Task<()> } so leaving the list or a second copy drops the timer

title: delete_folder_link writes LinkOp::Saving over an in-flight Saving; the Delete yes button is never disabled
trigger: Share Folder list: confirm Delete on link 1, then Delete on link 2 before the first answers
effect: Saving(r1) is dropped: r1's failure never shows and its dialog_answers entry is never taken; also an answer for r2 closes an Edit form the person opened meanwhile (settle_folder_share sets view to list)
fix: Refuse a new request while op is Saving and disable Delete/New/Edit on it

title: FolderEditorDialog::error sits beside FolderLoad (Failed(String) also carries a line)
trigger: Validation, merge fetch or save failures set error while load is Ready; Loading, Merging and Saving must have error None
effect: No bug found today; 'error only in Ready' is kept by hand in six writers and two error carriers exist (error and Failed(line)); InviteStage::Ready { error } in the same file has the right shape
fix: FolderLoad::Ready { error: Option<String> }

title: FolderShareDialog::selected and name_input belong to FolderShareView::Edit but live beside it
trigger: start_folder_link_form fills selected and name_input by hand when entering Edit; leaving to the list leaves them
effect: No bug today (always refilled on entry); the Edit form's fields are reset from a call site, not by the variant
fix: FolderShareView::Edit { link, selected, name } built whole on entry

title: GroupCallCreate::join_as is kept equal to CreateStep::ChooseJoinAs::selected by hand
trigger: Pick a row in the join-as box: select_create_join_as writes both selected and flow.join_as; accept_create_join_as writes step and join_as together; open_group_call_schedule copies join_as across steps
effect: No bug today; two fields that must change together, and join_as is meaningless in Leave and Waiting
fix: Carry the chosen sender in the variants (Confirm { join_as }, ChooseJoinAs { options, selected }, Schedule { .., join_as }) and read it from the step

title: created_video_chat writes group_call_boxes.create over an in-flight VideoChatCreate::Sent
trigger: Start a video chat in chat A, and before the answer start one in chat B (no call is tracked yet, so before_create is Proceed)
effect: The first request's id is dropped: its refusal shows no toast and its StreamJoinIntent::Created stays noted for chat A
fix: VideoChatCreate holds a set of Sent requests, or a new create is refused while one is Sent

title: CreateStep::Waiting has no cancel and draws no box
trigger: Start video chat while the getVideoChatAvailableParticipants answer is slow or lost
effect: The step is not shown (is_open is false), so Esc and Cancel cannot reach it; it leaves only on the answer, a replaced request, or a new begin_group_call_create
fix: Show the box in Waiting with Cancel (or give the stage a timeout owned by the stage's Task)

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog content closure
trigger: The kit dialog calls the content closure while another borrow of the same Rc<RefCell<Option<AnyElement>>> is live (not reachable today; the borrow is a one-line take)
effect: A BorrowMutError panic would end the process; same pattern in rtmp_stream.rs:575
fix: Rc<Cell<Option<_>>> with take(), or try_borrow_mut with a fallback element

title: Limit sliders keep an unsent or refused value after a failed setStorageOption
trigger: Drag 'Total size limit' while the send fails or TDLib refuses an option
effect: Slider and label show the new limit though TDLib holds the old one (error line goes to the shared slot, see 09e-002); the sliders are only rebuilt on the next visit
fix: Rebuild the sliders from storage_limits when the options answer with an error

title: MemberDialog::searched is written before the request goes out and kept when the send fails
trigger: Type a new member search, press Search while refresh_supergroup_members fails to send
effect: searched now names a query nothing was sent for; member_dialog_filter shows the cached (chat, Search) page of the previous query as this query's results, and load_more asks pages for the new query
fix: Set searched (and tab) only after the send returns Ok, or hold them as the key inside a Fetch stage

title: option_inputs, attach and quiz_correct_rows are parallel by row index, kept in step by hand
trigger: add_poll_option_row pushes two vectors; remove_poll_option_row removes from two and calls forget_correct_row; draft() joins by index
effect: No bug today; remove guards index < attach.len() because the invariant is not typed. quiz_correct_rows is by index while attach moved to OptionAttach::id for the same reason
fix: Vec<OptionRow { input, attach, correct }> with a stable row id

title: AttachMode::AwaitSticker/AwaitEmoji: one panel recipient stored in N slots and reset by loop
trigger: choose_poll_option_sticker and choose_poll_option_emoji first clear the mode in every slot, then set one; routing finds the slot by scanning for the awaiting mode
effect: No bug today; exclusivity of the media panel's target is a hand loop, and closing the panel leaves the slot waiting
fix: One PollDialog::panel_target: Option<(PanelUse, slot id)> instead of per-slot Await modes

title: OptionMediaSlot::Preparing(String): the probe answer is matched by path, and the read task is detached
trigger: Pick a video for an option; the read finishes in finish_poll_option_file, which looks for the slot whose media == Preparing(path)
effect: Answer is matched by the picked path, not by the slot id or a request held in the stage; two options with the same file, or the same file picked twice, take each other's result; removing the row or closing the box does not cancel the ffmpeg probe
fix: Preparing { slot: u64, read: Task<()> } matched by OptionAttach::id

title: PollAddOption::focus_on_mount is a one-shot bool taken with mem::take
trigger: open_poll_add_option sets true; build_poll_add_option_dialog takes it on first mount
effect: No bug today; the same one-shot is the PollPage::Opening stage in the sibling poll box
fix: A PollAddOption page stage (Opening, Form) like PollPage

title: ContactNote { Waiting, Seeded } has no failure and names no request; the fetch send is dropped with let _
trigger: Open Edit contact before the full user info; fetch_user_full_info fails to send or is answered with an error
effect: The note field shows the 'Loading' placeholder for as long as the box is open and nothing retries; Save sends null (note kept) so no data is lost
fix: ContactNote::{Waiting(RequestId), Failed, Seeded} settled by the answer

title: BirthdayDialog::error is set by validation and never cleared
trigger: Save an invalid birthday (error line), fix the fields, Save again and have TDLib refuse it (or edit and open the box again from Saving)
effect: The old validation line (submit_personal_photo.rs:198, drawn at :507) is still drawn beside the new refusal note and under 'Saving...'
fix: Clear error on every submit that passes validation, or tie it to the field values like ScheduleStep::error

title: ShareContact/ShareGame/AddBot use target: Option<i64> as the picker-or-confirm step
trigger: Pick a chat in the picker: target becomes Some and the box shows the confirm (AddBot: then the rights)
effect: No bug today; two stages encoded as None/Some, and AddBot's rights are meaningful only when target is Some
fix: A step enum per box (Pick, Confirm { chat }) holding the rights in Confirm

title: RestrictDialog::error (custom-time refusal) stays after the time is corrected, and sits beside submit
trigger: Restrict > Custom > pick a time outside 30 s to 366 days > Restrict (error line) > move the picker to a valid time (not a preset pick)
effect: The refusal line stays under the fixed time until the next successful send; only pick_restrict_until clears it. ScheduleStep::error in group_call_create.rs shows the safe shape: drawn only while the refused time is the picked one
fix: error: Option<(Option<i64>, &str)> drawn only while that time is picked, or fold into Submit

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog content closure
effect: BorrowMutError panic if the closure re-enters
fix: Rc<Cell<Option<_>>> take(), or try_borrow_mut

title: auto_download_answer is a one-shot slot in the session that nothing clears
trigger: Save a network editor; the Saved/Refused answer stays in SettingsState::auto_download_answer forever; only the RequestId match in after_answer keeps a stale one harmless
effect: None today (matched by RequestId); the slot is stale state that outlives its save
fix: consume the answer (take) when the editor moves out of Saving, or deliver it as an event to the stage
